title: Provenance Chain
intent: Carry origin, authorization, and transformation evidence through asset review.
problem: Without origin and authorization survive every transformation record, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the provenance chain contract.
context: This pattern addresses materials may become reusable candidates; its concrete control is origin and authorization survive every transformation record.
forces: Correctness requires that every derivative points to its immediate source
Operational pressure can cause: a transformation drops license metadata
solution: Implement origin and authorization survive every transformation record. Verify the anchored symbol `MaterialError` with `test_authorized_rights_allow_licensed_reuse` before reuse.
invariants: every derivative points to its immediate source
failure_modes: two sources merge without separate lineage
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `a transformation drops license metadata` and fails closed if the provenance chain evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For provenance chain, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to origin and authorization survive every transformation record.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: materials may become reusable candidates
Do not apply when: input is generated entirely inside the current transaction
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
not_when: input is generated entirely inside the current transaction
